given: a stock record has been filed for a SKU at a location
when: the operator retrieves the stock for that (sku, location) pair
then: the previously filed quantity and inventory_code are returned unchanged

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the write creates the record; AC2 asserts a later read returns the persisted values. A write could succeed while the read path returns stale or wrong data, so read-back is independently breakable from create.

architectural_notes: Read-back is a data-returning API contract exercised at the HTTP boundary (app/routes) delegating to app/services which reads through app/repositories; the observable outcome is the JSON response body, not a browser-rendered state, so it is verified at the API layer against the real branch DB. Cross-cutting: none beyond boundary serialization; no write transaction. Owner module: app/repositories stock repository for the read, surfaced by app/services.
